description:
This project contains EEG data from a task-based experiment investigating the effectiveness of a reward-based Attentional Bias Modification procedure using the N2pc component. Data were recorded from 102 participants using a Brain Products system and are provided in native BrainVision format (.eeg, .vhdr, .vmrk).

The dataset is organized according to the BIDS (Brain Imaging Data Structure) standard and includes raw EEG recordings, event markers, and accompanying metadata (e.g., channel information and acquisition parameters).

These data can be used to reproduce the analyses reported in (submitted) and to support further research on reward-based Attentional Bias Modification.
name: ABM20

description:
This EEG data set was recorded by the PainLabMunich (https://painlabmunich.de/) at the Technical University of Munich (TUM). 166 healthy participants took part in two identical experimental sessions, which were separated by one month. In each session, participants underwent a five-minute-long eyes-closed resting state recording. This was followed by an experimental pain paradigm applying 80 brief painful laser stimuli at 4 different intensities, for each of which a verbal pain rating was collected. Brain activity was recorded using EEG and skin conductance responses were measured. Prior to EEG recordings and EEG cap preparation, demographic and psychological variables were collected in each session, including questionnaires about sleep quality, anxiety and depression, positive and negative affect, and pain sensitivity. The original preregistration of the study can be found here: https://clinicaltrials.gov/ct2/show/NCT05616091.

name: Intra- and Inter-individual Differences of Pain - Data

description:
Behavioral and raw EEG data associated with the manuscript "Semantic distance differently modulates FPVS-EEG responses to words and pictures" accepted in Neurobiology of Language. 
The structure of the dataset follows the BIDS format, with data for each subject stored in its own folder, separately for behavioral and EEG data.
name: Dataset for "Semantic distance differently modulates FPVS-EEG responses to words and pictures"
